title: Apps
intro: Upload + manage the two generic Object Store buckets: app_packages (binaries) and scripts (manifest script bodies).

appPackages.title: App packages
appPackages.description: From /api/app-packages. Operator-curated installers / binaries keyed by <name>/<version>. The kanade-client app + third-party installers (Webex, Teams, custom MSIs) live here. 256 MB body limit.

list.empty: Bucket empty — upload a binary above (or POST to /api/app-packages/<name>/<version> via curl).
list.confirmDeleteDescription: Removes the bytes from OBJECT_APP_PACKAGES. This cannot be undone — re-upload to restore.

scriptObjects.title: Script objects
scriptObjects.description: From /api/script-objects. Manifest script bodies referenced by execute.script_object — agents fetch + sha-verify at exec time. 4 MB body limit, since these are PowerShell / shell bodies, not installer payloads.

list.empty: Bucket empty — upload a script above (or POST to /api/script-objects/<name>/<version> via curl).
list.confirmDeleteDescription: Removes the bytes from OBJECT_SCRIPTS. This cannot be undone — manifests referencing this object will fail at exec until you re-upload.
